testcase.name: CenterSuggestionTextToEnter has typed text or autocorrect as first suggestion
no 'ill' to 'I'll' if 'ill' has somewhat better ngram score
'ill' to 'I'll' if 'ill' not used before in this context, and I'll is whitelisted
typed word is first suggestion
'né' instead of 'ne' if 'né' has clearly better score in ngram context
no 'ne' instead of 'né'
next word and glide typing suggestions use automatic caps modes
autocorrect will "correct" capitalization with manual caps modes
shortcuts might be autocorrected by default
suggestions use manual caps modes
empty typed word gives next word suggestions
single letter suggestions are suppressed dependent on score of other suggestions
no 'né' instead of 'ne' if both with same score in ngram context
normal autocorrect works with manual caps modes
'né' instead of 'ne' if 'né' in ngram context
no English 'in' instead of French 'un' when typing in French
prefer next word suggestions
'ill' to 'I'll' if both have same ngram score
no autocorrect if more than one uppercase character in typed word, but not all uppercase
shortcuts are not autocorrected when setting is off
no 'né' instead of 'ne'
'on' to 'in' if 'in' was used before in this context
English 'I' instead of Polish 'i' when typing in English
no caps mode autocorrect if word has many uppercase letters
single quotes at end are attached to suggestions
typed word is second suggestion if autocorrect is pending
no English 'I' for Polish 'i' when typing in Polish
not 'ill' to 'I'll' if only 'ill' was used before in this context
tap typing suggestions depend on typed word capitalization, ignoring automatic caps modes
